verdict.rationale: The API documents a /identity_verification/retry endpoint for re-checks, and webhooks (STEP_UPDATED, STATUS_UPDATED, RETRIED) report session outcomes. An official Plaid MCP server exists, but nothing shows it exposes IDV operations, and session create/get endpoints are not explicitly shown. missing for 10: documented session-creation and retrieval endpoints for extracted data, MCP coverage of IDV, scoped/least-privilege credentials, published OpenAPI spec (probe 404).
